sources.snippet: The public Inception collection lists Jais-2-8B-Chat and Jais-2-70B-Chat, both under Apache 2.0, as well as GGUF quantizations added in February 2026. The standard repositories are gated: their pages are publicly visible, but downloading the weights requires a Hugging Face account and acceptance of the repository conditions [15][5][6].
